recipes.label: Dream on above and below
recipes.startdescription: Tonight I will dream of the relationship between heaven and earth

recipes.label: Dreaming of Above
recipes.startdescription:
To see a World in a Grain of Sand
And a Heaven in a Wild Flower
Hold Infinity in the palm of your hand
And Eternity in an hour
recipes.description:
I am refreshed and feel on top of the world
I am the size of the universe

recipes.label: Dreaming of Below
recipes.startdescription:
There is nothing but the breath
I am the breath
Other things are trivial
recipes.description:
I have gone back to earth
My dream helped me free myself from delusion

recipes.label: Dreaming as Above so Below
recipes.startdescription:
I am everywhere and nowhere simultaneously
The entire universe makes sense to me
I see everything and nothing at the same time
recipes.description:
I have gone earth and the Moon
I see everything clearly
free from delusion and bias
but inspired
recipes.comment: may want to make this enter you into the Mansus

recipes.label: Entering the Dark Forest
recipes.startdescription: Now I traverse through the foreboding undergrowth of gnarled, darkened trees. The moon retreats behind twisted branches, yet her spectral touch lingers within my hair. I stagger over the coiled roots, the temptation to yield to all fours intensifies to evade the suffocating foliage. In the fathomless depths of the night, spectral wings flutter ominously.

recipes.label: Entering the White Door
recipes.startdescription: Now I can approach the White Door through the Bounds. Now I can press my fingers to it, feel its chill, watch it swing open. As it opens, my mouth closes, tightens, heals over like a lost deformity. Around and about me is the cobalt light of the Mansus...

recipes.label: Dwell on my visions of doom
recipes.startdescription: An understanding neither dare speak aloud? A quarrel, and its aftermath?
recipes.description: This might permit me to hesitate.
